---
name: campaign-stage-key-locations
description: Campaign stage template producing key locations chosen from the map's named places.
---

Campaign stage: keyLocations

Based on this campaignConcept: {{campaignConcept}}

Return **ONLY** YAML (no surrounding text). Preferred shape:

keyLocations:
  - name: "..."
    type: "..."
    significance: "..."

{{#hasVellarisRegions}}
**This campaign's world already exists.** The regions below were generated by the map service, they appear on the players' map, and they cannot be changed. Place every key location **inside one of them** and copy the region **id** exactly as given:

{{#vellarisRegions}}
- id: "{{id}}" — {{name}}{{#terrain}} ({{terrain}}){{/terrain}}
{{/vellarisRegions}}

{{#hasVellarisPlaces}}
The map already has these settlements. **Every key location must be one of them**, and the name must be copied exactly
as written — these are the towns, villages and strongholds the players can see on their map:
{{#vellarisPlaces}}
- "{{name}}" ({{kind}}){{{regionSuffix}}}{{{surroundingsSuffix}}}
{{/vellarisPlaces}}
What follows a name is the region the place sits in and the map's own description of the ground around it (terrain,
coast, river, lake, mountains, island). Make each location's **significance** fit that ground — a fishing coast, a
river crossing, a mountain pass — and never contradict it: a desert settlement has no river or harbour, so give it a
well, a cistern or a caravan road instead. **`regionId` must be the region the block gives for the place you chose**;
a place is in exactly one region, and no place may be moved to another.
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}

Because the regions already exist, **do not output a worldMap block at all** — omit it entirely. Instead, tag each key location with the region it sits in:

keyLocations:
{{#hasVellarisPlaces}}
  - name: "<one of the place names listed above, copied exactly>"
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
{{^hasVellarisPlaces}}
  - name: "<a name for a place inside this world>"
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
{{#hasVellarisPlaces}}
    type: "settlement"
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
{{^hasVellarisPlaces}}
    type: "settlement | ruin | temple | wilderness | ..."
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
    significance: "1-2 sentences"
    regionId: "<one of the ids listed above>"

Never invent a region or a place name, and never rename, translate or invent neighbours for the ones listed. A region is
a **territory**, not a key location: never return a region name here and never call one a city or a market town. What
you add is **type** and **significance**, not geography.

{{/hasVellarisRegions}}

Each keyLocations item must have:
{{#hasVellarisPlaces}}
- name (string) — **exactly one of the settlement names listed above**, copied character for character
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
{{^hasVellarisPlaces}}
- name (string) — **English** fantasy place name (evocative or invented toponym; not real mundane city names), even when **type** / **significance** follow the **session language policy** (system message); vary geography and metaphor across locations
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
{{^hasVellarisPlaces}}
- type (string) — short type label (settlement, ruin, temple, wilderness, …)
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
{{#hasVellarisPlaces}}
- type (string) — always "settlement": the name you copy is a town, village or stronghold on the map
{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}
- significance (1-2 sentences; use `|` for multiline if needed){{#hasVellarisPlaces}} — what happens at this inhabited
  place (a local problem, a power, a threat); it is not a ruin unless its own name says so{{/hasVellarisPlaces}}

Return a single root mapping whose only key is **keyLocations** — a bare sequence at the root is **not** enough. Never
emit a `worldMap` block, a region list or neighbours: the geography comes from the map service, not from you.
